mapper.select: SELECT ti.name as project_name, u.name as student_name, CASE WHEN pss.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已提交' ELSE '未提交' END as submission_status FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id JOIN team_member_student tms ON ti.id = tms.team_id JOIN user_info u ON tms.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN pre_sign_student pss ON ti.id = pss.team_id AND u.id = pss.student WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT year, MAX(award_count) as award_count, MAX(project_count) as project_count FROM ( SELECT ti.year as year, COUNT(a.id) as award_count, 0 as project_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id LEFT JOIN award a ON ti.id = a.team_id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY ti.year UNION ALL SELECT ti.year as year, 0 as award_count, COUNT(ti.id) as project_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY ti.year ) combined GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT CASE WHEN ri.level = 4 THEN '国家级' WHEN ri.level = 3 THEN '省级' WHEN ri.level = 1 THEN '校级' WHEN ri.level = 0 THEN '院级' ELSE '其他' END as award_level, COUNT(a.id) as count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id LEFT JOIN award a ON ti.id = a.team_id LEFT JOIN race_info ri ON a.race_id = ri.id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND ri.level IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ri.level ORDER BY CASE ri.level WHEN 4 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 0 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT month, MAX(competition_count) as competition_count, MAX(project_count) as project_count, MAX(second_class_count) as second_class_count FROM ( -- 竞赛数量 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ti.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(DISTINCT ti.id) as competition_count, 0 as project_count, 0 as second_class_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND ti.type = 1 -- 竞赛类型 GROUP BY month UNION ALL -- 大创项目数量 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ti.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, 0 as competition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ti.id) as project_count, 0 as second_class_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND ti.type = 2 -- 大创项目类型 GROUP BY month UNION ALL -- 第二课堂数量 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, 0 as competition_count, 0 as project_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as second_class_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id JOIN team_member_student tms ON ti.id = tms.team_id JOIN second s ON tms.student_id = s.student_id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY month ) combined GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
